title:
The
                    Assassins of Memory: Essays on the Denial of the Holocaust
author: Ancient
content:
The Assassins of Memory: Essays on the Denial of the Holocaust

By Pierre Vidal-Naquet

This book consists of five essays: three long pieces and two short ones.
At present, the shortest piece, a newspaper column
titled "On the Side of the Persecuted", is only available in French.
However, since it is only a small portion of the book independent of the other
portions, I have considered this on-line book complete enough to list.
If an English version of the column is permitted to go on-line, 
I will add a link to it.

The English translations are by Jeffrey Mehlman, from a book published
by Columbia University Press.  The Columbia edition includes
a translator's preface, not included in this on-line edition.
